name: LinearMouse
title: LinearMouse: free SteerMouse alternative
caption:
SteerMouse charges $19.99 to fix a normal mouse on Mac. LinearMouse does it for free 🖱️

✅ Reverse scrolling on your mouse, and keep natural scrolling on your trackpad
✅ Turn mouse acceleration off, or tune the pointer speed
✅ Separate settings per device, per app and per display
✅ Remap your mouse buttons to shortcuts, Mission Control and more

dm_pitch: LinearMouse, the free open-source SteerMouse alternative 🖱️

beats.say: Why pay twenty bucks to fix your Mac's backwards mouse scrolling?
This app reverses scrolling on your mouse and turns off mouse acceleration.
SteerMouse costs nineteen ninety nine. LinearMouse costs nothing.
Flip the scroll direction on your mouse, and leave your trackpad alone.
Settings are per device, so your mouse and trackpad each get their own.
It also tunes pointer acceleration, speed, and what each button does.
Your mouse should have worked like this from day one.
